description: This file defines the GatewayConnectConfig struct, which encapsulates configuration data for establishing a connection to a gateway in an iOS app. It includes properties for URL, identifiers, tokens, TLS parameters, and options, along with a computed property that determines the effective stable ID used for persistence.

methods.name: effectiveStableID
methods.description: Computed property that returns a non-empty stable ID, falling back to the URL's absolute string if the stableID is empty or whitespace.
